text:
incident-bot: page fired -> gpu-memory-pressure | pool=redwood-prod-pool-7 | severity=high | reason=CUDA_ALLOC_FAILED :rotating_light:
pagerduty: alert routed to eng-oncall rotation (priority: P1)
alex: acked. i'm on it, pulling up prometheus + logs now.
sre-emma: thanks alex. which model is spiking?
alex: looks like fast-qa@v2 serving on pool-7. errors jumped ~65% in last 2m, tail latencies up. link: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc123
ops-kevin: seeing lots of this in node logs:
```
E 03/15 12:02:11 cuda: CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED: out of memory
E 03/15 12:02:11 runtime: failed to allocate 24.0 GB device memory for KV cache
E 03/15 12:02:12 worker: process 4821 stuck, mem usage 98% on a100-80gb
```
support-liz: customers reporting degraded responses and some 502s for the public fast-qa endpoint. CS has one incident open (cust: acme-inc).
alex: immediate mitigation plan:
- mark pool-7 readonly (prevent new allocations)
- drain and evict long-running jobs on pool-7 (evict candidates: jobs > 10m)
- fallback: route fast-qa traffic to model-variant fast-qa-small in pool-2
- if needed, scale pool-7 by +2 nodes (manual)
sre-emma: agree. also drop max_batch_size to 1 for fast-qa on the fallback variant to avoid burst allocations.
ops-kevin: running eviction command now:
```
# evict jobs >10m on pool-7
redwoodctl pool evict --pool redwood-prod-pool-7 --age 600 --reason "oom-mitigation"
```
ops-kevin: evict command completed, 7 tasks evicted, 3 of them were KV-heavy. reclaiming ~90GB.
pagerduty: alert acknowledged by alex. Escalating to oncall-tilly for handoff and customer comms.
oncall-tilly: taking over. thanks team. i'll monitor and coordinate with CS.
oncall-tilly: routing updated: fast-qa -> fast-qa-small (pool-2) via feature-flag flip. link: https://console/redwood/routing/flags/fast-qa
alex: routing flip done. traffic now ~65% on fallback. error rate halved. tail latency improving.
sre-emma: pushed runtime restart to 2 impacted workers (graceful) to clear stuck allocs.
ops-kevin: after restart and evictions, GPU memory usage on pool-7 fell to 45% aggregated. CUDA errors dropped to single digits/min.
support-liz: notified acme-inc that we're mitigating; will update them once errors are fully back to baseline.
oncall-tilly: current status: degraded -> partial service. customer impact limited to higher latency and occasional 502s for a subset of traffic. continuing monitoring for 30min.
alex: logging follow-up ticket with dumps and job IDs for postmortem: https://redwood/pm/INC-2026-3425
sre-emma: tentative root cause: sudden spike in KV-prefetch for a heavy prompt pattern + a new batching behavior from fast-qa@v2 that increased per-request allocation. need to verify with replay.
oncall-tilly: handoff plan: i'll stay on for 1 hour then hand to next rotation. please add any remediation actions to the incident ticket.
ops-kevin: one quick note: consider enabling early OOM eviction for KV cache (threshold 85%) — reduces noisy neighbors. filing a config change PR.
oncall-tilly: resolved for now — marking incident as mitigated. will reopen if errors climb back. documenting customer impact: acme-inc saw ~12% of requests 502/timeout window during the 8-minute spike. CS escalated.
sre-emma: we'll run a postmortem and include pressure thresholds + a test that replays the prompt shapes that caused this.
alex: thx everyone. closing Slack thread when the postmortem link is attached. :thumbsup:
